subject: Architecture
title: Borobudur: The Mountain of Buddhas
description: A fast breakdown of Borobudur: The Mountain of Buddhas for builders.

hook.text: On the island of Java, a Buddhist monument rises from rice paddies like a stone mountain with 504 statues.

buildup.text: Borobudur has nine platforms stacked in a pyramid shape, decorated with 2,672 relief panels.

discovery.text: Walking its corridors is a spiritual journey — reliefs progress from earthly desires to enlightenment.

twist.text: Borobudur was abandoned and buried under volcanic ash for 800 years before its rediscovery in 1814.

climax.text: UNESCO led a $25 million restoration. Over a million stones were dismantled, cleaned, and reassembled.

punchline.text: A volcano buried it. A jungle hid it. Millions visit it now.

quiz.question: How long was Borobudur hidden before rediscovery?
